candidates.complexity: Existing whole-view preflight unchanged. Single String unit: directory locate then at most one per-chunk Bloom reject; scans only compatible leaf windows. Worst case still linear in visible units/chunks, with collisions requiring exact search. No added persistent index or KMP table for eligible searches.
candidates.selection: Select for scoped review with measured tradeoffs. Existing chunk Blooms reject impossible leaves, Java21 bounded String search scans eligible String leaves, owned pieces keep exact unit reads. First valid unit is read before Bloom/range dispatch. Late fixtures become much faster and eligible searches remove the KMP failure array. First-hit pooled median is 1.92% slower, generic StringBuilder fallback 13.97% slower on this local run; original general KMP source and callback schedules remain exact. No universal speed/no-regression claim.
